title: From time-lapse to orchestration: recovering physics across a field of structures
program: many-structure time-lapse -> detect+track -> motion field (PIV-analog) -> curvo Bayesian inverse per structure -> orchestration model
data_reality: No accessible real dataset carries the modality + per-structure force ground truth; synthetic-first with a real-ingestion seam (modality adapter). IDR reachable but no CME/caveolae force-paired live-cell time-lapse; EMDB static/no-force.

method_transfer.PIV: kinematics (velocity) input, transfers partially; NOT force
method_transfer.TFM: apparatus does not transfer; its measured-displacement->inferred-force INVERSE STRUCTURE does
method_transfer.curvo_inverse: the actual physics recovery (Helfrich + active stress, nested sampling, calibrated cov68 0.96 rel_bias +2.0% on the single-CCP gate)

step2_field.note: N validated single-pit renders composited with staggered lifecycles + per-structure GT tracks

step3_tracking.sweep: 100% of structures detected across crowding 4-12 and photons 80-400
step3_tracking.note: recall reported on detectable subset (coat above optical floor); nascent pits' first ~7 frames physically undetectable

step4_motion.finding: PIV inflow is a noisy kinematic proxy (weakly tracks constriction) but carries NO force information (r=-0.08, p=0.79) -> velocity != force; the physics inverse is required

step5_recovery.mode: oracle track (isolates inverse from tracking), 3 seeds
step5_recovery.finding: crowding roughly halves identification (25% vs 60%) and degrades coverage (0.50 vs 0.96); identified subset still recovers force to ~6%. End-to-end from recovered tracks is tracking-limited (fragmentation).

step6_orchestration.falsifiable_statement: Curvature generation (coat/wedge) and active (actin) force are ORDERED in time within a structure: coat-driven curvature onset PRECEDES actin-force onset by a positive lag (field median 3 frames). Orchestration is sequential (curvature-first), not simultaneous.
step6_orchestration.proposed_experiment: Two-color TIRF time-lapse of CME with a coat marker and an actin marker; measure per-pit onset times of coat curvature vs actin recruitment and test the sign of the lag distribution against zero.

mechano_claim.subject: clathrin_coat
mechano_claim.note: LINKED tier carries NO physical value (credibility firewall); the lag magnitude lives in the model block, the claim asserts only the causal ORDER + a refuting experiment

rl_affordance: The validated forward model (forces->images) + guarded inverse (images->scored forces) constitute a scored simulator: an RL environment where an agent's proposed force/mechanism is scored against recoverable ground truth. Documented as a downstream affordance; NOT built here (per user: the aim is to scale the science).
honest_scope: Anchor = clathrin pits + actin co-player (validated physics). Caveolae/actin-as-object need new first-principles modules, out of scope. Every accuracy number is on synthetic data where truth is known.
